commentary_title: Panamax Index drops amid vessel speed changes
commentary_summary: The Panamax tonne-miles index declined by 4.4% in week 18 in tandem with falling ballast and laden speed. | Laden speed in the West dropped, accompanied by a decrease in the percentage of laden vessels in the region as vessels sought employment. | Vessels at anchor in the East increased 15.5% MoM, followed by increased congestion of both ballast and laden vessels in the East. | Laden tonnage in India increased due to increased thermal coal imports, which hit a 10-month high, led by a surge in shipments from Indonesia, resulting in improved market sentiments.
